column4: The run horizon hid the effect: herb's mean generation is ~2.3 where the degenerate-optimum risk needs ~6, and the entry itself says the prediction is untested rather than refuted.
Counterexample from the experimental record (sharply peaked and Gaussian-like avalanche distributions against SOC's power law), plus a superseding two-angle plus velocity-weakening model.
Arithmetic: +/-15% of an integer plastochron base of 2 rounds back to 2, so one flat width cannot vary an integer trait at all.
Superseding shipped rule measures 18x better (-76 against -1,357/-1,534) and both narrower forms fail by construction because the scree is deeper than GRAIN_FOOTING_PROBE, still 8 in src/sim/load.rs.
The entry's own re-test (six seeds, same-session main rebuild, commit 5da9f75d) found the -25% shortfall was a stale-baseline artifact and the shipped size clears the bar by a wide margin.
A ratio bound is scale-free, so it cannot bound absolute size; measured as a 13% biomass tax that changed nothing about saturation.
Contradictory requirements across two games: a local humidity reading cannot tell a sealed bed from an open puddle, resolved by a discriminating bit (World::enclosure) rather than any rate.
The thing rejected is the sweep's terrain preset - an instrument choice, not an engine mechanism.
A neighbouring subsystem swamps it: the float's own broken gate puts 96% of airborne frames on power and 55% of colony burn on lift, and alive is 0 on all six runs either way.
A RegionMap region is 102-256 columns, a fifth to a half of the window the contrast is judged in, so the gate cannot express the feature; superseded by Purpose::RockCountry at 1700 columns.
Count-to-infinity during partial convergence is structural to spreading the solve across frames at MAX_SITES_PER_FRAME; terrain visibly crumbles on a fresh world.
The clamped quantity is not the binding one - the constraint is span through torque = M x arm, so relieving mass is a no-op wherever roof-cell mass is already under the cap.
Non-termination: a structural failure that cannot convert its cell is rescheduled forever (42,267 failures against 302), and log.ron still ships breaks_into.
Redundant by construction - support_parent re-derives the identical argmin from stored distances - plus the position-keyed side table is the documented determinism trap (issue #7).

Measured paired on four world seeds and negative on the tree's own seed budget (launch_price 1.87x per seed), with a named condition - allocate_to_frontier's surplus going to zero at the ceiling - that changes the arithmetic.
Arithmetic: the interpolation weight must normalise over the FIELD_SCALE-wide field cell, not over one world unit.
A constant denominated in raw summed field light is invalidated by construction by any light-model or cluster-size change; superseded by the per-node currency.
Arithmetic: three of eight headings are blocked on flat ground, so a uniform re-roll returns to the blocked state over a third of the time by construction.
Counterexample: attenuating through empty air caps tree height at ~21 rows; superseded by the per-column cast with lateral bleed only.
Transitive attachment closes over everything standing on the floor - the exact structure that made all four earlier support models indestructible; the bonus must be an edge property.
The condition (the heightfield steps landing) was met, 8 was retried and still missed the bar (31 units residual against 20 allowed), and it landed at the measured 16.
The thing rejected is the guard scene's size - a harness cost decision, not an engine mechanism.
Counterexample judged by eye: all eight measured trees capped with a flat horizontal plate; superseded by the Lockhart (P-Y) taper.
Counterexample: the tip dies at the edge of any wet ground without drinking, contradicting what root growth exists to do.
A withdrawn suspicion about what caused a collapse, with no mechanism attached - a retired inference.
The one-row probe cannot reach where the overload failures happen, so it is too narrow by construction; superseded by the bounded downward cover probe still in arch_span.
The entry records RE-OPENED: par_solve_tiles' serial fallback, which the regression rested on, has been removed and the re-measurement is explicitly owed and unrecorded.
A per-column transform cannot see 2D adjacency to standing water, so every above-table pond is unseeded by construction and capillarity pays at runtime (82 awake frames against 31).

A discrete 1.8x density allele (WOOD_DENSITY_ALLELES 0.75..1.35) lets one mutation buy the whole escape, so the shape gradient is never touched - against the stated intent that mechanics shape growth patterns.
The thing rejected is a capture instrument (BitBlt/PrintWindow); the shipped workaround is the in-app framebuffer dump the headless xvfb route still uses.
Measured space cost (43 px over at every spacing, 2 px at the tightest) with a named condition that changes the arithmetic - a wider framebuffer, a third bar row, or retiring a widget.
Cost grows with settle traffic by construction (pending 26 to 4,064, frame 2.5 ms to 3,160 ms) and a bounded in-tick chain walk supersedes it, with no reopening condition named.
Measured end-to-end as O(width squared) and negative inside 512 columns, with the crossover named (streamed M10 widths) and the ratio already converging 2.6x to 1.2x across 50-400 columns.
The regions handed to fracture were already one cell thick (mass 115 torque 6555 = one row), so ladder tuning is vacuous; superseded by D1's section union.
The blocker was fixed (edge_with_room, present in liquid.rs today) and promotion was re-measured: still worse than plain CA, spread 57-68 against 128.
The rejected thing is the harness's tunnel= spacing and the bore inferences drawn from it; the non-monotonic result is retracted, not a mechanism.
Arithmetic: at a cut the whole cross-section is loosened so the mean equals the minimum, and the grading removes the per-cell weakness that is the spalling mechanism itself.

The named condition - a mechanism for a full body to notice open floor and shed back to CA - exists today as edge_with_room in liquid.rs, and the register's automatic-promotion entry records the re-test: still worse than CA.

The live half of the rejection (16 against 4) rests on three seeds whose population and pile halves disagree seed by seed; the entry itself says three seeds is not a sweep and asks for a six-seed re-read.
A binary outcome contradicts the owner's stated law that an outcome is a distribution; superseded by the power-of-two fragment ladder.
A withdrawn inference about what a counter measured - a retried action counts duration, not loss - with no mechanism rejected.
Counterexample: the out-of-bounds BEDROCK sentinel becomes an infinitely tall ladder and ants walk up the side of the world forever.

Arithmetic: a Bellman-Ford increase advances one unit per round, so suppressing the rise abandons a ~2,400-round correction the field genuinely owes - and the bounded-range condition it names is explicitly still unmet.
Binary cannot-fail immunity is the precise structure the four earlier support models were rejected for, and together the three hatches switched the model off for player structures.
The confound it was measured under - the column-moment defect - was fixed in 0b5b175 (verified in the history), and the worldcrack/flat re-run the entry itself asks for is unrecorded.
The freed-slot condition is met and taken: the scalars left aux for the OrganismCell sidecar, and OrganismCell.support now caches the anchor distance per cell, recomputed by plant::anchor_support.
Sign error: a down-default makes GrowingTip's positive upward_weight reward downward growth, and the claim it contributed nothing was wrong.
The thing rejected is the detonation-visibility metric itself - changed-pixel count over grain-jittered rendering.
Randomised HashMap iteration order against a committed determinism requirement, plus cost proportional to pending rather than due sites; superseded by the min-heap with a deterministic tiebreak.
Arithmetic impossibility: a gale makes the air over a puddle and over a lake read identically (2.31 to 0.23 in ten frames), so no function of humidity can separate them.
Counterexample measured backwards: a sealed room retained less total pressure than open terrain because nearly every interior cell borders a wall.
Counterexample: the raft wound to MAX_SPIN_RATE and sat wedged at the surface identically at 600 and 3,000 frames; superseded by the existing carried term with no new constant.
A floor applied with max never spreads, so the drying front travels untouched (brake saturated at 0.77 against HUMID_STOP 2.0); superseded by writing vapour into the diffusing moisture channel.
Same arithmetic impossibility as the gale case: advected humidity reads identically over puddle and lake, so the second factor must come from the never-advected moisture-source stencil.
Counterexample: 27,386 blocked ticks and an unbroken wall on screen while creatures remain mutually impassable; superseded by four-apart founder spacing.
The CFL stability condition is an arithmetic bound on any explicit pipe/shallow-water solver, not a tuning choice - never built because impossible.

The driving input never left the regime's wrong end - Crowding median 1.000 with p90 and max pinned - and the 33-seed sign test has 17% power against a true rate of 0.60, so the null cannot exclude a modest effect.
Counterexample: label_component from a failing cell sweeps in the whole mountain the overhang is still attached to; the predicate must use the distances structural.rs has already written.
Measured paired from one forked world state (-31% and -39% roofed void) with a named condition that changes the arithmetic - galleries deeper than a few rows under the crust.
Priced end-to-end by its own instrument at 0.6% of the frame against a real mid-tick restructuring risk, with the named condition (step_organisms growing, or a cell list stable across a tick).
A maintenance bill that does not vary with the hour compared against instantaneous night-scaled income is phase-dependent by construction, so the stand sheds on a nightly cycle.
field.rs leaves velocity unclamped, so a shockwave dominates the growth term by construction; superseded by a fixed-magnitude direction-only wind read.
Counterexample: rays from one blow cross near the origin, so reach is identical after one blow and after two and nothing is left for the next to build on.

A measured-slower verdict (16 to 64 ms) taken before the field cost baseline was rebuilt - tiles are now ChunkMap<FieldTile> with fxhash, not the pointer-chased HashMap - and fire.rs still reads only cell temperature, so nothing has re-measured it.
The setting's measured effect (downwind preference 0.53 against a fair 0.5) is below visibility and a measured replacement at 2.0 shipped.

CONDITION MET and verified in source: structural::organism_is_supported no longer exists and plant::anchor_support runs from the anchors with no span budget, while the entry says the positive control on the replacement is still owed.
Randomised per-process HashMap iteration order against the committed same-build determinism requirement; BTreeMap or a sorted Vec is the recorded replacement.
The named condition is food worth more than a leaf being reachable: fruit.ron and windfall.ron ship at 960 food_energy and litter at 480 today, and no re-run of the gut arm is recorded.
The thing rejected is the hand-built stand-in scene - an instrument choice, corrected by a generated-terrain arm.
Counterexample: restoring the fallback re-inerts three of four mutation operators (delete 0%, recondition 2%, insert 8%), and FateLookup::GenomeOnly ships.
The condition it names - thicken()'s counting fix, PLAN.md item 3 - landed, and tree/conifer/creeper/shrub now ship pipe_ratio 5.5, below the 6.0 this entry rejected.
Arithmetic: nearest-neighbour fill diffusion needs order width-squared frames, which no setting of reach 1 escapes; reach 8 was derived from the 100-cell measurement.

Counterexample: 203 cells shoved with the waterline flat to the pixel, because fill_dimming draws a fifth of a cell as shadow and the sweep drops it back; superseded by a carried remainder spent in whole cells.
Arithmetic: paint starts at aux 0 and the true distance climbs one round per ~5 frames, so a 192-cell column takes over fifteen seconds to decide; superseded by seeded regional re-convergence.
Counterexample: all 15,840 cells still at aux 0 with zero load evaluations at frame 3,000, and low-x structures starving every other check.
The offset's premise is gone - apply_sky now writes arriving light at occupied blocks - so the workaround is itself the bug, and its guard tests fail under the old rule.
Counterexample: stale_ticks is the entire termination mechanism, so suppressing it makes a resource-starved tree grow forever.

The named condition is a silhouette lever that texture and colour actually move; per-species palette bands now differ by species (foliage_bands/bark_bands) and flower and fruit organ cells ship, with no probe re-authored.
Arithmetic: 9 metamers at plastochron 4 is exactly the 36-cell turgor ceiling ((0.32-0.1)/0.006), so the axis terminates on height as it reaches its count.
Counterexample: two write seams bypass World::set (the parallel worker's same-chunk writes and set_owned replay), and a falling seed vanished from its organism's cell list.
The structural-check confound was stripped and the hard threshold was re-judged on four paired measurements (crown separation, standing-canopy light, synchronised culls, transient dips): still no.
Every bedding plane is exactly strata_thickness apart, so six real materials render as equal stripes by construction; superseded by a rock unit spanning ~1.8 beds with a noise-warped count.
Arithmetic: candidates one cell apart land in the same FIELD_SCALE block and compare exactly equal, so the tie-break decides the heading.
The extend/demote cycle is a structural thrash that moves no water at all; outflow by demotion requires both the cooldown and the CA sweep alongside.
A kernel sum over a regular lattice ripples at the lattice period by construction, and the normalising denominator carries the same ripple so it cancels - nearly free.
Arithmetic: proportional mutation of a 0.0 brain weight can never grow a connection, so one width cannot serve both plant traits and brain weights.
The thing rejected is the harness's default scene population, which bin/lab.rs never uses (it opens at founders 0) - reviving it would change measurements, not the game.

Arithmetic: the germination floor sits above the uptake-limitation point (246/290 against 191/234), so below it the bed is empty rather than scarce; herb's soil_water_threshold is unchanged since 2026-08-29 and the shipped uptake constant has not moved, while nobranch losing 13 points on 12 of 12 shows the arm had teeth.
Retired by a constructed counterexample where row-total and per-run give opposite answers (23 cells across 9 runs read as one 23-wide stem), and leaves sat on both sides of the ratio.
Rule A: delete the noisy three-seed sweep and the finding survives - 91-96% of roofed void is already one connected run, so the scatter the mechanism was built to focus does not exist.
The thing rejected is the cave-survival metric, whose conflation is structural to the measure.
A backward step does not change which end the head is, so the rule cannot resolve the state it fires on (809 fires, 49.0% still refused); superseded by the in-place reversal.
The two placement rules fail in opposite directions (backfilling the gallery, or every pellet down the nearest shaft), and the superseding mechanism puts the choice in the genome as drop_urge.
Every number was measured in the 20-row-sky scene later found invalid, and the entry says the values must be re-derived in the grove scene before reuse - a scene that contradicts the code.
Consuming world.rng draws breaks the committed determinism requirement, and the clumping is structural to a random subset; the even stride does neither.
Arithmetic: nearest-neighbour-only transfer is order width-squared, an exponent no flow_rate setting changes; HORIZONTAL_TRANSFER_REACH is the replacement.
Arithmetic: buoyant_share is strictly positive even in air, so a gate written against 0.0 can never fire; superseded by CRUISE_MAX_BUOYANCY as a classifier.
Counterexample once the vacuous condition expired: with roots able to grow, non-retiring tips multiplied the frontier into horizontal mats across the whole bed.

Both extremes are degenerate - k=2 holds everything, k=8 measures identically to arching off - so neither can discriminate, and the sweep sits after the row-of-circles correction in the same handoff section.

Measured paired over five presets and four seeds at a median ratio of exactly 1.00x with a 70.6 ms worst frame against a 60 ms budget; the binding constraint is joint density and the repeat bonus, not search reach.
Unclamped field velocity means a shockwave dominates the lean by construction; superseded by a direction-only term at fixed WIND_LEAN_MAGNITUDE.
Contradictory requirements: the shelf and column cases share one base constant, so no single multiplier can recalibrate one without breaking the other.

Both halves of the rejection are unreplicated single-run numbers on eight founders (6-8 of 8, wood:leaf 2.35 against 2.19) in a system whose per-genome spread runs 31-153 cells; delete them and nothing rejects.
Arithmetic: four +/-1-cell sensor probes land in one FIELD_SCALE block about seven times in eight, so min_by degenerates to picking the first candidate.

The constant contradicted its own justification - field capacity is where a drained column rests - so the rule fired in ordinary damp ground; superseded by SOIL_WATERLOGGED with a founders=0 control isolating the threshold from the digging.
Arithmetic: both lateral sensors sit in open air for a side-view surface walker, so right minus left is identically zero and no gating can recover a zero signal.
